artifacts.description: CSV, JSON or Parquet files. Each becomes a view named from its file: sales.csv is sales, artifact-aa.csv is artifact_aa.

intake.description: A file he sent. Its view is named from the file, so sales.csv is sales.

tables.description: Pasted CSV by table name. For small data given in chat.

sql.description: DuckDB SQL over those tables. One query; its rows come back, the first 200 inline.

save_as.description: Also returns the whole result as a file in this format. name sets the file stem; otherwise result.

name.description: Saved file name without extension, when save_as is set. Letters and digits are kept; other characters become underscores.
